events.title: Morning Melodies with Rhydian at Currumbin RSL
events.location: 165 Duringan Street, Currumbin, QLD, Australia, Queensland 4223
events.description: Join us on the second Tuesday of each month for our FREE Monthly Morning Melodies, a delightful musical experience now located downstairs in the lounge area at Currumbin RSL. This FREE event begins at 10:30am through to 12:00pm, with doors to the club opening at 10:00am, giving you plenty of time to find a seat and get comfortable. Each month will features a new artist performing all the best tunes from the 60s, 70s and 80s! This is a non-ticketed event open to members and non-members, so mark your calendars for a truly enchanting morning. We also invite you to enjoy a delicious lunch afterwards and recommend booking a table in advance.

events.title: Tech Related Travel Tips | Fun & Ageless
events.description: Discover how to make your next trip stress-free with our beginner-friendly 1.5-hour workshop. Learn simple, easy ways to use your digital devices as a travel guide, translator, and organiser, plus get handy tips for packing smart, navigating safely, and staying connected. Perfect for anyone looking to take the hassle out of holiday planning. Tea/Coffee station available. Located upstairs at Currumbin RSL Presented by Claire from Basic Tech
